outline.chapter_title: Introduction to Text-to-Image Diffusion and Fine‑Tuning Challenges
outline.description: Sets the stage by reviewing modern text‑to‑image diffusion models, the need for downstream control, and the limitations of existing fine‑tuning approaches.
subtopics: Overview of large text‑to‑image diffusion models (Stable Diffusion, Imagen, etc.)
Downstream tasks: subject‑driven generation and controllable generation
Desiderata for fine‑tuning: efficiency vs. preservation of pretrained knowledge
Why simple Euclidean‑distance based fine‑tuning is insufficient

outline.chapter_title: Geometric Foundations: Hyperspherical Energy and Neuron Angles
outline.description: Introduces the geometric concepts that motivate Orthogonal Fine‑Tuning, focusing on hyperspherical energy and its relation to semantic information.
subtopics: Definition of hyperspherical similarity and hyperspherical energy
Interpretation of neuron directions on the unit hypersphere
Empirical evidence: angular features vs. magnitude in auto‑encoders
Mathematical invariance of hyperspherical energy under orthogonal transforms

outline.description: Derives the OFT objective, explains why orthogonal transformations preserve hyperspherical energy, and formulates the layer‑wise optimization problem.
subtopics: Formal statement of the OFT principle
Derivation: minimizing the hyperspherical‑energy difference → orthogonal matrix
Forward‑pass modification with a layer‑shared orthogonal matrix
Comparison with conventional fine‑tuning and LoRA

outline.description: Covers practical ways to represent and learn orthogonal matrices with low computational cost.
subtopics: Cayley transform and skew‑symmetric matrix Q
Block‑diagonal orthogonal matrices and block‑sharing strategies
Parameter‑count analysis vs. LoRA and full‑rank updates
Implementation details (initialization, gradient handling, numerical stability)

outline.description: Extends OFT by adding an explicit radius constraint, improving stability and limiting deviation from the pretrained model.
subtopics: Motivation for an ε‑ball around the identity
Deriving the ε‑constraint via the Neumann series approximation
Projected gradient enforcement on the skew‑symmetric matrix
Effect of ε on flexibility vs. preservation (illustrative plots)

outline.description: Discusses the optional magnitude‑scaling diagonal matrix, its impact on expressivity, and other possible extensions.
subtopics: Formulation of re‑scaled OFT with learnable diagonal D
Why scaling does not affect hyperspherical energy
Empirical gains from re‑scaled OFT (summary of appendix results)
Potential directions: multi‑task composition, adaptive block structures

outline.description: Shows how OFT integrates with the DreamBooth pipeline, evaluates stability, convergence, and quantitative metrics.
subtopics: Recap of DreamBooth fine‑tuning objectives
Replacing standard weight updates with OFT/COFT
Training dynamics: iteration‑wise stability plots
Metrics: DINO, CLIP‑I, CLIP‑T, LPIPS – interpretation of results
Qualitative case studies and human evaluation summary

outline.description: Demonstrates OFT in ControlNet‑style tasks, introduces the new control‑consistency metric, and compares against baselines.
subtopics: Control signals: Canny edges, segmentation maps, facial landmarks
Fine‑tuning setup: layers, epochs, data splits
Control‑consistency metrics (IoU, F1, L2 landmark error) – definition and rationale
Convergence speed analysis vs. ControlNet, T2I‑Adapter, LoRA
Quantitative tables and qualitative image comparisons

outline.description: Places OFT within the broader landscape of model adaptation methods.
subtopics: LoRA: low‑rank additive updates
Adapter‑style methods and prompt‑tuning
Orthogonal over‑parameterized training (Liu et al.) – similarities and differences
Parameter efficiency, inference overhead, and scalability

outline.description: Step‑by‑step instructions for integrating OFT/COFT into existing diffusion pipelines.
subtopics: Code skeleton (PyTorch pseudo‑code) for Cayley‑parameterized OFT
Choosing block size r and ε for COFT
Memory and compute considerations for large models
Tips for hyper‑parameter tuning (learning rate, epochs, seed robustness)
Deploying the fine‑tuned model with zero inference overhead

outline.chapter_title: Limitations, Open Problems, and Future Directions
outline.description: Critical discussion of current constraints and promising research avenues.
subtopics: Scalability of matrix inverse in Cayley transform
Compositionality of multiple orthogonal transforms
Bias introduced by block‑diagonal parameterization
Potential for dynamic/learned block structures
Extending OFT to other modalities (video, audio) and architectures (ViT, ConvNeXt)

outline.description: Recaps the main insights, reinforces why orthogonal fine‑tuning is effective, and highlights practical benefits for students and researchers.
subtopics: Key theoretical insight: preserving pairwise neuron angles
Empirical advantages: stability, speed, quality, parameter efficiency
When to choose OFT/COFT over other methods
Checklist for applying OFT to a new downstream task
